excerpts.section: ERC 2025 First Aid, Concise guidelines for clinical practice, Concussion
excerpts.text: Suspect a concussion if a person has difficulties with thinking/remembering, displays physical symptoms (headache, change in vision, dizziness, nausea or vomiting, seizures, sensitivity to light/noise), emotional changes or changes in behaviour (increased sleepiness, reduction in normal activities, loss of responsiveness, confusion).

excerpts.section: ERC 2025 First Aid, Concise guidelines for clinical practice, Concussion, activity
excerpts.text: Remove the person from physical activities.

excerpts.section: ERC 2025 First Aid, Concise guidelines for clinical practice, Concussion, referral
excerpts.text: Refer to a healthcare professional for assessment and further advice.
